item.itunes:title: Episode 75 - Rude Awakening
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang meets Rina, the Minister of Elunore in the island of Loręndale. It doesn't take long on this new island for the group to realize that this is not the happy and welcoming place that they hoped it might be. Would Rina be any different, and when will they locate Brenna's family? Find out these answers and more, right now!

item.title: Episode 82 - Holiday Special
item.itunes:title: Episode 82 - Holiday Special
item.description:
On this, extra-special Holiday episode, the gang must discover the source of the frozen plague being cast upon Elunore, and work together to restore it to its former self. Would they be able to free the land from its eternal winter, and what dangers would they face along the way? Find out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, email us at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com, or leave us a review on iTunes! Thanks to our friends at https://battlebards.com for letting us use their sound effects, and also to Filmstro, the worlds first soundtrack creation studio. Check it out for yourself at https://filmstro.com. Huge thanks to Ryan Confer Productions for recording and mastering the special choir intro for today's episode. Find out more about him on Facebook.
